summary: In many practical deployments of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD), the server processes data in batches. summary: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). title: A two-stage diffusion-driven morphogenesis model with evolving connectivity
summary: Morphogenesis of diatom silica shells involves a sequence of topological transitions: initially separate ribs grow and branch, then merge through bridges, leaving a regular network of pores. title: Whose Values, Which Contexts, and What Signals? Grounding Cultural Value Alignment with Re3Culture
summary: Cultural value alignment requires not only model optimization but also a well-specified target grounded in real-human evidence. Abstract questionnaire profiles weakly recover situated priorities, and communities differ in which scenarios they identify as culturally value-revealing. Preferences conflate value agreement with other response-level qualities, and similar answers can be derived from different value priorities. By addressing these requirements, Re3Culture provides the first human-grounded resource that explicitly informs target definition for cultural value alignment.

title: Implicit Assumptions About Tasks in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is the study of how a model accumulates knowledge from data received over time, rather than all at once. title: Query-Efficient Quantum Multi-Objective Optimization for Materials Configuration Search via Bayesian Weight Selection
summary: Materials design is a multi-objective problem, and recent advances in quantum optimization make it possible to bring quantum solvers to bear on such problems.
